title: Learning to Disperse, Learning to Reconnect
subtitle: Communication-Aware Learned Multi-Robot Exploration
overview: This research investigates how multi-robot teams can learn to disperse for efficient environment coverage while retaining the ability to reconnect when communication becomes fragmented. The approach explores decentralized decision-making under communication constraints and explicit connectivity recovery.
current_progress: Initial simulation experiments have investigated decentralized belief representations, communication connectivity, and reconnection behavior. Current development focuses on learning-based coordination and evaluation under constrained communication.
